claim: NIST's CHIPS R&D Office revised BAA 2025-NIST-CHIPS-CRDO-01 on 20 April 2026 into two application paths (an NSTC Investment Fund Path and an R&D Project Path), and on 2 September 2026 announced a temporary pause from 15 September 2026, expecting to reopen in November 2026; white papers may be submitted through 30 September 2029.
evidence: "On April 20, 2026, CRDO launched the Investment Fund for the National Semiconductor Technology Center (NSTC). The Investment Fund will be administered through the BAA, which has been revised to have two application paths – the Investment Fund Path and the R&D Project Path." ... "On September 2, 2026, CRDO announced that the BAA would temporarily pause on September 15, 2026 due to system upgrades at NIST. CRDO expects to begin accepting BAA applications again in November 2026" ... "may be submitted by or before September 30, 2029, via grants.gov." (NIST CRDO BAA page, last updated 28 Sep 2026)

claim: Under the 48D final regulations, construction can be shown to have begun either by the physical work test (physical work of a significant nature) or by a five percent safe harbor (paying or incurring 5% or more of the total cost of the property), in both cases followed by continuous construction or continuous efforts.
evidence: "(d) Five percent safe harbor--(1) In general. Construction of a property will be considered as having begun if: (i) A taxpayer pays or incurs (within the meaning of Sec. 1.461-1(a)(1) and (2)) five percent or more of the total cost of the property; and (ii) Thereafter, the taxpayer maintains continuous construction or continuous efforts."; "Under the physical work test, construction of an item of property begins when physical work of a significant nature begins, provided thereafter that the taxpayer maintains continuous construction or continuous efforts." (T.D. 10009, 89 FR, 23 Oct 2024, Sec. 1.48D-5(c)(1), (d)(1))
